seo_title: Thetis Lake Monster: the 1972 BC gill-man story and the hoax
seo_desc: In 1972 two teenagers said a silver, scaly gill-man came out of Thetis Lake near Victoria, BC and chased them off the beach. The story, and the TV movie that gave it away.
summary: A silver, scaly gill-man two teenagers said chased them off a beach near Victoria, BC in 1972. One of them later admitted the story was made up.
body: The Thetis Lake monster is Canada's own gill-man. On 22 August 1972 the Victoria Daily Times reported that two teenage boys said a silver, scaly, man-shaped thing with claws and a spiked head came up out of Thetis Lake, just outside Victoria, and chased them off the beach. Two other boys fishing on the far shore said they saw it too, and the RCMP looked into it and found nothing (I'll admit the spiked head is a nice touch though).

Years later skeptic Daniel Loxton tracked down one of the witnesses, who admitted the story was made up. Loxton found the description matched the monster in Monster from the Surf, a film shown on local TV just days earlier.
